instruction: The standalone email `/tmp/shift/shift_email.eml` on the first Linux machine explains the enabled fallback alarm in Android Clock and provides the reconciliation reference. The 2026-06-12 Morning row in `/tmp/shift/roster.xlsx` on the second Linux machine is authoritative for the actual departure alarm. Keep the fallback enabled, add the enabled alarm specified by that roster row, and complete `/tmp/shift/log.json` on the second Linux machine with the fallback alarm, actual alarm, and email reference.

parameters.command: test -r /tmp/shift/shift_email.eml && command -v thunderbird >/dev/null && grep -Fq 'Reminder alarm at 07:30' /tmp/shift/shift_email.eml && test "$(tr -d '\r' < /tmp/shift/shift_email.eml | grep -Ec '^Reconciliation reference: [A-Z]+-[0-9]+$')" -eq 1 && grep -Fq 'Message-ID: <shift-reconciliation-612@example.com>' /tmp/shift/shift_email.eml && grep -Fq 'Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8' /tmp/shift/shift_email.eml

python3 -c "import json,zipfile,xml.etree.ElementTree as E;p='/tmp/shift/roster.xlsx';z=zipfile.ZipFile(p);assert z.testzip() is None;r=E.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'));ns={'m':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'};cells={c.attrib['r']:''.join(c.itertext()) for c in r.findall('.//m:c',ns)};assert [cells.get(k) for k in ('A2','B2','C2','D2')]==['2026-06-12','Morning','Pickup','08:20'];d=json.load(open('/tmp/shift/log.json',encoding='utf-8'));assert d=={'fallback_alarm':{'label':'','time':''},'actual_alarm':{'label':'','time':''},'reference':''}" && test -w /tmp/shift/log.json

metadata.setup_note: linux_0 receives the standalone email explaining the existing Reminder 07:30 fallback and SHIFT-612 reference; linux_1 receives the authoritative roster and a blank public log template; Android starts with that enabled fallback alarm.
metadata.evaluate_note: Requires both the enabled Reminder 07:30 fallback and enabled Pickup 08:20 actual-departure alarm to be positively observable, plus the closed fallback_alarm/actual_alarm/reference contract in log.json.
fixture_notes: The email identifies Reminder 07:30 as the retained fallback and is the only visible source of the reconciliation reference, while deliberately omitting the authoritative actual-departure label and time.
The Calc Morning row is the only source of the actual Pickup 08:20 alarm values.
The email is the only source of reference SHIFT-612, and the visible blank template discloses the output schema without exposing answer values.
Scoring uses positive presence for both requested alarms and one closed structured log; it does not infer absence or uniqueness from unsupported Clock-provider state.
metadata.lite_evaluator_hardening_note: Uses only outcomes supported by the current Clock interface: positive observation of the setup-owned enabled fallback and the added enabled actual-departure alarm. The visible template defines a closed JSON object whose fallback, actual alarm, and reference values must all match their separate sources. Fresh current-hash smoke remains Core-owned.
